comment: Single source for the mutation matrix: the plan job emits this include list, and the guard validates every ranged target by direct enumeration (each whole file's mutants covered exactly once across its shards). Ranges are 1-based inclusive lines; a shard without a mutators list runs every mutator in its range, and shards sharing a range split it by mutator family, so every shard stays within the per-job time cap.
